name: ipscout
description: Ping hosts, sweep a subnet, measure round-trip time and packet loss, run a traceroute, scan ports, read the greeting each host sends on a port (banner grab) and its SNMP system group (uptime, name, description), look up MAC addresses and the neighbour cache and write a static entry to it, query routes and the default gateway, list interfaces and subnets, send wake-on-LAN, find the path MTU, and watch a DHCP handshake for the address of a machine just started - from Python or the shell, without shelling out, and as an ordinary user with no root or Administrator rights for everything but the static entry, the DHCP watch, the active MAC and SYN probes, and traceroute on macOS. Ships the python-network-probe skill: the library API, the CLI with its JSON envelope and exit codes, the raise-on-setup-problems error contract, and the measured platform limits.
